payload.query:
mutation subscriptionPay($input: [PayInput!]!, $allowRecurring: Boolean, $callbackUrlTemplate: String, $amount: Float, $byCard: Boolean, $newCard: Boolean, $instantRefund: Boolean, $saveCard: Boolean, $orderObjectId: String, $userEmail: String) {
  subscriptionPay(
    input: $input
    allowRecurring: $allowRecurring
    callbackUrlTemplate: $callbackUrlTemplate
    amount: $amount
    byCard: $byCard
    newCard: $newCard
    instantRefund: $instantRefund
    saveCard: $saveCard
    orderObjectId: $orderObjectId
    userEmail: $userEmail
  ) {
    ...orderDataFields
  }
}

fragment orderDataFields on OrderData {
  Amount
  CardId
  Details
  ErrorCode
  ExpDate
  Message
  OrderId
  Pan
  PaymentId
  PaymentURL
  RebillId
  Status
  TerminalKey
}
